notes: Camera struct base in rsi at activecam_write2 intercept (movups [rsi],xmm3). XYZ at +0x00, 4x3 rotation matrix at +0x10 (stride=4 floats: right.xyz=[0,1,2] up.xyz=[4,5,6] fwd.xyz=[8,9,10]). FOV at separate global address (fov_read AOB), not in main struct. Multiple redundant write sites -- all NOPped to freeze camera. RT-capable via NVIDIA RTXGI on Enhanced Edition.

intercepts.name: activecam_address
intercepts.description: Global camera struct pointer. RIP-relative address at bytes 3-6 of pattern resolves to struct base. Also backup matrix write at this site.

intercepts.name: activecam_write1
intercepts.description: Matrix row 0 write to global (movaps [global],xmm12). 8 bytes.

intercepts.name: activecam_write2
intercepts.description: XYZ coords write (movups [rsi],xmm3). rsi = camera struct base.

intercepts.name: activecam_write3
intercepts.description: Ansel FOV write + matrix rows 1-3 (movss [rsi+0x4B4] + movups [rsi+10/20/30]). NOP 12 bytes.

intercepts.name: activecam_write4
intercepts.description: Matrix row 2 write to global (movaps [global],xmm6). Additional rows 1 and 3 at +0x15 and +0x3A from this AOB.
